nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S Voice Agent UI Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Dark minimalist full-screen voice call UI: centered 5-bar audio visualizer as the agent's presence indicator, bottom control bar (mic toggle with device selector, camera, screen share, chat) and red END CALL button. Header shows LiveKit logo and 'Built with LiveKit Agents'. Bottom-left Next.js dev overlay ('1 Issue') indicates screenshot taken from local Next.js dev server.

nodes.label: GTA I CSS3D Project
nodes.rationale: Recreation of classic top-down GTA I using pure HTML/CSS 3D transforms.

nodes.label: GTA CSS3D Project Thumbnail
nodes.rationale: Top-down view of red sports car on gray asphalt road between beige city buildings, radial motion blur for speed; bold white pixel-style 'GtA CSS3D' title with black outline evoking classic GTA I logo. Serves as portfolio card cover image.

nodes.label: Pac-Man Animation Sprite Sheet (animations.gif)
nodes.rationale: Horizontal strip of 8 yellow Pac-Man frames (mouth fully open to closed) on transparent background; frames are sliced by the canvas game to animate Pac-Man's chomping mouth.

nodes.label: ghost.png (Ghost Sprite Sheet)
nodes.rationale: 2x2 pixel-art sprite sheet of the four classic Pac-Man ghosts (red Blinky, orange Clyde, pink Pinky, cyan Inky), white eyes with blue pupils, on white background; single image sliced by ghostImageLocations offsets to draw each ghost color
